name: – After recital J – Am 5
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: Ja. whereas in recent years such environmental disasters have occurred, causing tragedies in several European regions, including in Italy, with particular reference to Marche, Emilia-Romagna and the island of Ischia, as well as in Germany and Belgium, with devastating consequences for both people and local infrastructure and economies;
